purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official Tampa GIS Tax Parcel layer documents polygon geometry, HCPA parcel provenance, supported GeoJSON queries, and daily updates. HCPA identifies itself as county property appraiser. Direct bounded WUP-point GeoJSON request returned HTTP 403; geometry not independently verified.
registryAssessment: Hillsborough County Property Appraiser is the county valuation office; City of Tampa GIS publishes a Tax Parcel ArcGIS polygon layer sourced from HCPA and updated daily. A bounded point-intersection request to the official FeatureServer returned HTTP 403, so no geometry sample was retained.
